name: arc-kit
description: The user's daily session defaults (arc), standalone planning and review skills (brainstorming, plan-auditor, executor, verifier), supervise, debug, research, writing, handoff, refactor, conventions, fresh-air, the test-runner, worker, and reviewer agents, and the comment-lint, test-guard, arc-compact, destructive-guard, and agent-git-guard hooks.

comment_lint_enabled.title: Comment lint
comment_lint_enabled.description: Flag wrapped, overlong, banner, and multi-line block comments added by Edit/Write

comment_lint_width.title: Comment lint max width
comment_lint_width.description: Maximum columns for a single-line comment

test_guard_enabled.title: Test guard
test_guard_enabled.description: Ask the agent to justify or delete each test case it adds to a test file

destructive_guard_enabled.title: Destructive command guard
destructive_guard_enabled.description: Deny or ask before destructive Bash commands (recursive rm of root paths, git discards, SQL drops, infra teardown)
